notes.title: The curse extends to more countries
notes.notes:
Get ready, the curse extends to more countries with the new translations that we have just added in the new patch and the next ones we are preparing.

New languages added:
-Aleman
-Korean
-Japanese
-Chinese (Simplified)
-Bug fixes.

The next languages to be added will be:
-Italian
-Portuguese
-Spanish
-Russian
-French
